First Appeared: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6}
Status: Active
Affiliation: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.XkO2NGJCUTmTTq3F]{Beaver Lake} colony

Description

An ambitious young beaver, called Tam for short, descended from Aspen — the beaver for whose sake @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} first settled at @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.XkO2NGJCUTmTTq3F]{Beaver Lake}.
He has risen to lead the colony in the conviction that the beavers should not be confined to one dam but should dam the whole river.

Role

Under Tamarack's leadership the beavers have begun damming the lower @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.ncbPkt06UQ9WQ2BL]{Ashen Flow} beyond their old home, cutting into the orchards and farms of the lowlands and becoming pests.
This has soured the Vale's great families against the colony and lies at the heart of the beaver-vs-Vale conflict.
Castor admires his drive but fears it will get the colony exterminated.

Relationships

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} — The colony's respected elder, who admires Tamarack's ambition yet fears where it leads; a conflicted protégé-figure
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.XkO2NGJCUTmTTq3F]{Beaver Lake} — His home colony, which he now leads

Key Events

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} — Established as the upstart leader driving the beavers to dam the lower Ashen Flow, fracturing the colony's old ways and souring the Vale against them

Session Appearances

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} — Discussed but not present
